definitions.explanation: An enclosed space within a building, separated by walls and a door.

examples.english: My room is on the second floor.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}して→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{部屋|へや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}しました→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{部屋|へや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明|あか}るくて→明るい：00616_akarui⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This room is bright and spacious.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦ノック→ノック：03868_nokku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please knock before entering the room.

notes:
{部屋|へや} is the general word for any room in a building.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {部屋|へや}を⟦{借|か}りる→借りる：00532_kariru⟧: to rent a room
- {部屋|へや}を⟦{掃除|そうじ}する→掃除：02889_souji⟧: to clean a room
- {部屋|へや}に⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter a room
- ⟦{空|あ}き{部屋|べや}→空き部屋：noentry⟧: vacant room

ROOM TYPES:
- ⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧: Japanese-style room (tatami)
- ⟦{洋室|ようしつ}→洋室：15741_youshitsu⟧: Western-style room
- ⟦{寝室|しんしつ}→寝室：05300_shinshitsu⟧: bedroom
- ⟦{居間|いま}→居間：01745_ima⟧: living room
- ⟦{客間|きゃくま}→客間：00257_kyakuma⟧: guest room

COUNTER:
Rooms are counted with {部屋|へや}: 1{部屋|へや}, 2{部屋|へや}. For apartments: 2LDK, 3LDK, etc.
